heard: The moon's surface dust smells like burnt gunpowder. Solar radiation gives those grains an electrostatic charge. A thin exosphere leaves regolith exposed to space. These razor-sharp particles actually levitate above the ground. Surface gravity there is only one-sixth of Earth's. Exactly twelve humans have ever walked on that soil. Those twelve explorers smelled it on their suits after returning to the lander. They were shocked to discover that the alien dust gave every single astronaut lunar hay fever. Our only neighbor is covered in dust that smells like burnt gunpowder.
